name: ProofWP – Shoppable Video Reviews for WooCommerce
author: Debuggers Studio

sections.description:
Turn Real Customer Reviews Into Shopping Confidence

ProofWP is a WooCommerce video reviews and photo reviews plugin that helps online stores collect, manage, and showcase authentic customer feedback. Display customer photos, video reviews, product ratings, and user-generated content (UGC) in modern review widgets designed to build trust and support buying decisions.

Go beyond traditional text reviews. Showcase real customer experiences alongside the products being reviewed, helping shoppers discover what other buyers think before making a purchase.

With ProofWP, you can collect reviews automatically, highlight products within review widgets, and display customer feedback using customizable grids, sliders, review feeds, and social proof elements throughout your WooCommerce store.

Live Demo | Documentation | ProofWP Pro

Why Choose ProofWP?

Your customers are already sharing valuable feedback about your products. ProofWP helps you make that feedback more visible, engaging, and useful to future shoppers.

  • Showcase photo and video reviews: Let shoppers see real products through customer photos and videos.
  • Connect reviews with products: Display tagged WooCommerce products alongside relevant customer reviews.
  • Collect customer feedback automatically: Send post-purchase review requests and encourage buyers to share their experiences.
  • Build trust with social proof: Highlight verified reviews, star ratings, testimonials, and trust badges.
  • Display reviews anywhere: Add customizable review feeds, sliders, and widgets to product pages, landing pages, and other areas of your store.

Whether you’re running a fashion store, beauty brand, electronics shop, or another WooCommerce business, ProofWP helps make your customer reviews a more valuable part of the shopping experience.

WooCommerce Video Reviews & Product-Linked Social Proof

Bring your customer reviews to life with authentic video content.

ProofWP allows customers to submit video reviews showing their experiences with your products. Instead of relying only on written feedback, shoppers can see products being used and hear what customers think.

Features include:

  • Collect customer video reviews through WooCommerce review forms.
  • Accept photo and video attachments with customer feedback.
  • Display video reviews inside customizable review layouts.
  • Show associated WooCommerce products within review widgets.
  • Combine videos, photos, written reviews, and star ratings.
  • Showcase customer-generated content on product pages and throughout your store.

Product tagging helps shoppers identify which item each review refers to, bringing customer experiences closer to product discovery.

Collect Photo & Video Reviews Automatically

Make it easier for customers to leave meaningful reviews after purchasing from your WooCommerce store.

  • Photo Reviews: Allow customers to upload real product photos with their reviews.
  • Video Reviews: Collect customer-submitted videos that demonstrate product experiences.
  • Automated Review Requests: Send review request emails following purchases or order delivery.
  • Verified Customer Reviews: Highlight feedback from verified WooCommerce purchasers.
  • Guest & Anonymous Reviews: Support flexible review submission and reviewer privacy options.
  • Customizable Review Forms: Collect customer ratings, written feedback, and visual media.
  • Review Moderation: Approve, edit, and manage customer reviews before displaying them.

Display Customer Reviews With Beautiful Widgets

Turn customer reviews into engaging social proof across your WooCommerce store.

ProofWP includes flexible display options designed to fit different store layouts and branding styles.

  • Review Grid: Showcase customer reviews in a clean, responsive grid.
  • Review Slider: Highlight customer feedback in an interactive carousel.
  • Modern Review Feed: Display photos, videos, ratings, and written reviews together.
  • Customer Testimonials: Feature customer experiences outside traditional product review sections.
  • Star Ratings & Review Summaries: Help shoppers understand customer satisfaction at a glance.
  • Product Tags: Display the product associated with each customer review.
  • Trust Badges: Add reassuring social proof throughout the shopping experience.
  • Social Proof Notifications: Showcase store activity and customer feedback.

Automated Review Requests for WooCommerce

Getting customers to leave reviews can be challenging. ProofWP helps simplify the process with automated review collection.

Send review request emails after purchases or order delivery, encourage customers to submit photo and video reviews, and manage incoming feedback from your WordPress dashboard.

ProofWP Pro also includes follow-up reminders for customers who haven’t submitted their reviews.

Manage WooCommerce Product Reviews in One Place

Keep your review collection and moderation workflow organized.

  • Manage customer reviews through a centralized dashboard.
  • Approve, edit, and organize review submissions.
  • Manage customer photos, videos, and star ratings.
  • Create review widgets from selected customer feedback.
  • Configure review forms and display settings.
  • Import existing reviews from supported review platforms.
  • Use built-in caching to support efficient review widget performance.

More Features With ProofWP Pro

Upgrade to ProofWP Pro for advanced review presentation and automation features.

  • Stacked review slider layouts.
  • Accordion-style review sliders.
  • Marquee and masonry-style review displays.
  • Floating customer review widgets.
  • Advanced widget display conditions.
  • Automated follow-up review reminders.
  • Advanced review summary positioning and styling controls.
  • Review schema generation features.

Works With WooCommerce, Elementor & Gutenberg

ProofWP is built for WordPress and WooCommerce.

Display customer reviews using supported Elementor widgets, Gutenberg blocks, and shortcodes. Customize review layouts to suit your store’s branding and showcase customer feedback on product pages, landing pages, and other WordPress pages.

Build Trust With Real Customer Experiences

Customers want to know what they’re buying. Product photos and descriptions provide information, but authentic customer reviews help shoppers understand how products perform in real life.

ProofWP brings customer video reviews, photo reviews, star ratings, and product-linked social proof together in one WooCommerce review solution.

Collect better reviews. Showcase real customer experiences. Help shoppers buy with confidence.

What’s Next?

If you like ProofWP, then check out our other WordPress plugins designed to help you increase engagement, conversions, and sales.

ReelsWP – Easily add fast, mobile-friendly vertical video grids and reels carousels to your landing pages, blog posts, news articles, or product pages. Tag products inside videos and create shoppable video experiences.

Marquee Addons – Makes it easy to add smooth marquee effects for text, buttons, images, testimonials, videos, and cards to Elementor websites with continuous scrolling loops for your content.
sections.faq:
Can customers submit video reviews in WooCommerce?

Yes. ProofWP lets customers submit video reviews alongside written feedback, photos, and star ratings through WooCommerce review forms.

How do I add photo and video reviews to WooCommerce?

Install and activate ProofWP, configure your review forms, and enable photo and video submissions. You can then collect customer reviews and display them using customizable review feeds and widgets.

Does ProofWP support shoppable customer reviews?

ProofWP supports product tagging within customer review widgets. This allows store owners to display the associated WooCommerce product alongside relevant customer feedback, helping shoppers identify the products featured in reviews.

Can I display customer video reviews on my WooCommerce homepage?

Yes. ProofWP supports flexible review displays through widgets and shortcodes, allowing you to showcase customer reviews on product pages, homepages, landing pages, and other supported WordPress pages.

Does ProofWP send automated review request emails?

Yes. ProofWP supports automated WooCommerce review request emails after purchases or order delivery. Additional follow-up reminder functionality is available in ProofWP Pro.

Can I import existing WooCommerce product reviews?

Yes. ProofWP offers review import and migration tools for supported review plugins and platforms, including Judge.me and ReviewX.
